gamerule.customspeed.adultvillagerbreed_: Time in seconds before villagers can breed again
gamerule.customspeed.babyvillagergrowup_: Time in seconds for baby villagers to grow into adults
gamerule.customspeed.adultanimalbreed_15: Time in seconds before animals can breed again
gamerule.customspeed.babyanimalgrowup_60: Time in seconds for baby animals to grow into adults
gamerule.customspeed.spawnerspeed_20.des: Time in seconds between mob spawns from spawners
gamerule.customspeed.allayduplication_30: Time in seconds before an Allay can duplicate again
customspeed.config.use:
use the command line to use this mod:/gamerule customspeed... 
 all the times are in SECONDS and the default time is indicated in the gamerule name in the end, Do not put a value smaller that one it will not work 
customspeed.adultVillagerbreed_150 The time for a villager to mate again 
 customspeed.babyVillagergrowup_600: The Time for a Baby Villager to grow up 
 customspeed.adultAnimalbreed_150: The time for an Animal to mate again 
 customspeed.babyAnimalgrowup_600: The time for a Baby Animal to grow up 
 customspeed.Spawnerspeed_20: The time for a spawner to spawn mobs
gamerule.customspeed.turtlecrackchance_5: A Turtle Egg cracks normally once per night, there is also a low chance for cracks during the day (1/500). Lower this value for faster cracks
